settings.text:
Processing time
Orders ship in 1-2 business days (excluding weekends/holidays).

Shipping rates
Orders under $150 ship for a flat $6.99 rate (shown at checkout). Free shipping on orders $150+.

Tracking
Tracking is emailed as soon as your label is created.

Where we ship
We currently ship within the United States.

Delivery time
Carrier transit times vary by location and are separate from processing time.

Questions
Email support@stonebrookcollectibles.com.
